channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: St. Rita’s Father Tom McCarthy To Lead Chicago St. Patrick’s Day Parade
item.description: The Rev. Tom McCarthy, who is friends with Chicago-born Pope Leo XIV, will serve as grand marshal of the March 14 Downtown St. Patrick's Day Parade.

item.title: What’s Next For Austin’s Mars Candy Factory? Neighbors Weigh Development Proposals
item.description: The Wrigley Mars factory, closed in 2024, was to be redeveloped into 500 residences and other amenities. Unsatisfied with those plans, neighbors have released their own proposal for the site.

item.title: Englewood Residents Can Earn $50 To Test Their Water For Lead Through Free University Study
item.description: Researchers at Northwestern University hope to recruit 116 households in Greater Englewood, a community "overburdened with pollution," to test their drinking water.

item.title: 15 Candidates Vying To Replace Danny Davis, Represent 7th Congressional District
item.description: It's a crowded race to replace longtime Rep. Danny Davis, who announced his retirement last year after serving 15 consecutive terms in Congress.

item.title: These Chicago Pastry Chefs Are Competing On Food Network’s ‘Ultimate Baking Championship’
item.description: Casey Doody, Juan Gutierrez and Christopher Teixeira are among 16 chefs competing on Food Network’s newest pastry show, premiering Monday.

item.title: Ainslie Arts Plaza Construction To Resume In Lincoln Square
item.description: Starting next week, crews will install new traffic lights at the Ainslie and Western intersection and finish work on the plaza.

item.title: Chicago Pride Parade Returns June 28 With ‘Free to Be Proud’ Theme
item.description: The parade will honor journalists, civil rights leaders and judges as grand marshals while continuing the recently revised route through Lakeview.

item.title: The Original Mr. Beef Opens Location At Midway Airport
item.description: The legendary River North beef stand — made even more famous by FX's "The Bear" — opened its second location near gate B14.

item.title: Controversial North Center Mural Of Slain Ukrainian Refugee Vandalized
item.description: The mural of Iryna Zarutska was initially painted by Barcelona-based street artist SAV45 at the end of January, thanks to financial backing from Elon Musk and his allies.

item.title: Chicago Fire Break Ground On New Stadium While Neighbors Push for Community Benefits Agreement
item.description: The new stadium, which will serve as an anchor for The 78 megadevelopment, has the support of fans and elected officials, but a coalition of community groups say they've been shut out.
